description: The permission HappyView's admin API asks for. An app gets it when you approve dev.happyview.adminFull at sign-in. It names a permission, not an endpoint: HappyView's admin API isn't XRPC, so there is nothing to call here.

main.description: Manage HappyView instances as an admin: deploy projects, install plugins and change settings, with the permissions you hold on each instance.
